test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons in a company with preference for different foods for lunch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b15c66deb18f9fd5da10ceb207772ae7cc9a394cbae903c59762a80016cf9df.png] 

How many people prefer salads but NOT stew?
solution:
• The shaded part represents the people prefer salads but NOT stew.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d57f2f35db22dcb2aae535e82fb21968179193c0070467953ad135c08023b01.png] 

 
• The number representing the people prefer salads but NOT stew = 29 + 12 = 41

Hence, **‘41’** is the correct answer.
